archetypes.name: dyn-settle-dispatch
archetypes.rationale: Verify the centralized settle-wrapper rc dispatch preserves site-specific Gate A and Gate B semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new settle-rc-dispatch reference and each caller replacement. Check that wrapper exit-status dispatch is not conflated with POSTPLAN_RC stdout parsing. Verify rc 0, 1, 10, 12, and 13 still route differently for Gate B versus Gate A / discussion-round2 where required. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-structure-pins
archetypes.rationale: Check the structural harness pins the new canonical reference without fragile markdown parsing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review scripts/test-design-structure.sh changes. Confirm the added assertions cover the new reference, caller adjacency, and removal of inline rc tables. Look for overly brittle literals, missing caller coverage, or assertions that could pass while drift remains. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
